'''Alrym II''' was the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lanthrym]]. He was a plain looking, spindly man. Alrym II did not go anywhere without his six [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] guards and his two female companions.
